cells.gaps: Nothing dated on or before the as-at says the computerised main courante went live in any commissariat or brigade: the newest usable fact is December 2023, when it was over 80% built and due by mid-January 2024. The minister's statement that it is achieved is dated 2 October 2026, after the as-at, and sets nothing; BFA-001 and BFA-002 are from the excluded source. No plan, finance, station count or event in the last twelve months is held.
cells.note: A named platform for commissariats and brigades was being built by the ministry in December 2023, inside 36 months of the as-at, which is preparation. Stage 3 needs the system live in stations outside the capital, and no fact inside the as-at shows any station using it.
